_comment: ASCENSION CATALOG (plan-ascension.md C3 step 3): D9's 'at least one unique combination', and the only skill in this batch that is NOT a re-type — it is a fusion, which is what a combination is for. Frostbite (the frost aura) + FrostShield (slow whatever touches you) → an aura that damages AND slows everything it damages. ⭐ D1 WORLD-PARITY, anchored on SUPPRESSION (id 59) rather than on the ceiling trio, and the anchor is the whole argument: Suppression is the shipped frost damage+slow combination, authored as a ~70% side-grade explicitly 'below the §A ceiling'. This sits at Suppression's damage numbers exactly and trades its two axes: Suppression is the LONG-range kite (radius 2.6→3.1, LRS-derived) with a weak slow (0.07+0.07/L, 0.35 at max); this is the CLOSE-range brawl (radius 1.0, Damage-derived) with the Slow aura's own full curve (0.1+0.1/L, 0.5 at max). Equal power, opposite range/control trade. It cannot be a strict upgrade of either parent or of Suppression, which is the SWG-Hologrind failure D1 exists to prevent. ⚑ Both effects share ONE tickInterval (40) per R3/F5, so they price against the same health in the same tick; the damage is authored FIRST because that is the effect the skill is for, and near the resource floor the first effect is the one that still fires (manual-content-authoring §2). The slow is unpriced, exactly as Suppression's is. ⚑ Secret, never documented in-game, like every recipe. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
